findings.passage: "AI-generated content in political ads is a growing concern nationally and here in Indiana," Olthoff said. "Having a disclaimer will help voters more easily identify fake ads, which ultimately helps protect the integrity of our elections."
findings.note: Press release from the Indiana House caucus quoting her on her law requiring a disclaimer on AI-altered candidate images, audio or video in campaign ads. Not about ID or citizenship; saved as a related election-integrity topic.
